<style>
  :root {
    --bg: #0f1115;
    --card: #181b22;
    --text: #e8e9ec;
    --muted: #9aa0ad;
    --accent: #ff5a36;
    --on-accent: #fff;
    --line: #262a33;
    --header-bg: rgba(15,17,21,.92);
    --photo-from: #2a2f3a;
    --photo-to: #1a1d25;
    color-scheme: dark;
  }
  :root[data-theme="light"] {
    --bg: #f5f6f8;
    --card: #ffffff;
    --text: #1b1e25;
    --muted: #5d6472;
    --accent: #ff5a36;
    --line: #dfe2e8;
    --header-bg: rgba(245,246,248,.92);
    --photo-from: #e3e6ec;
    --photo-to: #f1f2f5;
    color-scheme: light;
  }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
  body {
    font-family: "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, Arial, sans-serif;
    background: var(--bg);
    color: var(--text);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }
  .container { max-width: 1000px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 20px; }

  /* Шапка */
  header {
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
    position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10;
    background: var(--header-bg);
    backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
  }
  .header-inner {
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    min-height: 64px; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px 16px;
  }
  .logo { font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .5px; }
  .logo span { color: var(--accent); }
  .header-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; }
  .theme-switch {
    position: relative; width: 58px; height: 30px; flex: none;
    border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid var(--line);
    background: var(--card); cursor: pointer; padding: 0;
    transition: background .25s, border-color .25s;
  }
  .theme-switch .knob {
    position: absolute; top: 2px; left: 2px; width: 24px; height: 24px;
    border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 13px; line-height: 1;
    transition: transform .25s;
  }
  .theme-switch .knob::before { content: "🌙"; }
  :root[data-theme="light"] .theme-switch .knob { transform: translateX(28px); }
  :root[data-theme="light"] .theme-switch .knob::before { content: "☀️"; }
  .theme-switch:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }
  body, header, .course, .feature, .contact, .tags span { transition: background-color .25s, color .25s, border-color .25s; }

  nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 6px; }
  nav a {
    color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none;
    font-size: .95rem; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 999px;
    cursor: pointer; transition: color .2s, background .2s, transform .1s;
  }
  nav a:hover { color: var(--text); background: var(--card); }
  nav a:active { transform: scale(.95); background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); }
  nav a.active { background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font-weight: 600; }
  nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }

  section { position: relative; padding: 112px 0; scroll-margin-top: 64px; }
  section + section::before {
    content: ""; position: absolute; top: 0; left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: min(960px, calc(100% - 40px)); height: 14px;
    background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent) 0 3px, transparent 3px 10px);
    opacity: .45;
    -webkit-mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 30%, #000 70%, transparent);
    mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #000 30%, #000 70%, transparent);
  }
  h2 { font-size: 1.8rem; margin-bottom: 32px; }
  h2::after {
    content: ""; display: block; width: 48px; height: 3px;
    background: var(--accent); margin-top: 10px; border-radius: 2px;
  }

  /* О себе */
  .about { display: flex; gap: 48px; align-items: center; }
  .photo {
    flex: 0 0 320px; height: 400px; border-radius: 16px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--photo-from), var(--photo-to));
    border: 1px solid var(--line);
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    color: var(--muted); font-size: .9rem; text-align: center;

  .photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; }

  .role { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; margin-bottom: 18px; }
  .about p { color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 28px; }
  .btn {
    display: inline-block; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--accent); color: var(--on-accent); font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none; transition: transform .15s, box-shadow .15s;
  }
  .btn:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(255,90,54,.35); }

  /* Курсы */
  .courses { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
  .course {
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 28px;
    display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  }
  .course h3 { font-size: 1.2rem; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .course p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; flex: 1; margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .price { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); }
  .price small { font-size: .85rem; color: var(--muted); font-weight: 400; }

  /* О студии */
  .studio-text { max-width: 760px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 1.05rem; margin-bottom: 36px; }
  .features { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px; }
  .feature {
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 28px;
  }
  .feature .num { font-size: 2rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent); margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .feature h3 { font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .feature p { color: var(--muted); font-size: .95rem; margin: 0; }

  .about p { margin-bottom: 16px; }
  .tags { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; margin: 4px 0 24px; }
  .tags span {
    padding: 6px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--card); color: var(--text); font-size: .85rem;
  }
  .stats { display: flex; gap: 28px; margin: 0 0 28px; }
  .stats b { display: block; font-size: 1.6rem; color: var(--accent); line-height: 1.2; }
  .stats span { color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; }

  /* Контакты */
  .cta-text { font-size: 1.15rem; margin: -12px 0 28px; max-width: 640px; }
  .contacts-list { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; }
  .contact {
    background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--line);
    border-radius: 16px; padding: 22px;
  }
  .contact .label { color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem; margin-bottom: 4px; }
  .contact a, .contact div.val { color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 600; }
  .contact a:hover { color: var(--accent); }

  footer {
    border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 24px 0;
    text-align: center; color: var(--muted); font-size: .85rem;
  }

  @media (max-width: 800px) {
    .about { flex-direction: column; text-align: center; }
    .photo { flex: none; width: 100%; max-width: 320px; height: 380px; }
    .about h1 { font-size: 1.9rem; }
    .courses, .features { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .tags, .stats { justify-content: center; }
    nav { gap: 0; }
    nav a { padding: 8px 10px; font-size: .88rem; }
    .logo { font-size: 1.05rem; }
  }
</style>

<script>
  (function () {
    var links = document.querySelectorAll('nav a');
    var ids = Array.prototype.map.call(links, function (a) { return a.getAttribute('href').slice(1); });

    function setActive(id) {
      links.forEach(function (a) {
        a.classList.toggle('active', a.getAttribute('href') === '#' + id);
      });
    }

    links.forEach(function (a) {
      a.addEventListener('click', function () {
        setActive(a.getAttribute('href').slice(1));
      });
    });

    function onScroll() {
      var y = window.scrollY + 120, current = ids[0];
      ids.forEach(function (id) {
        var el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (el && el.offsetTop <= y) current = id;
      });
      if (window.innerHeight + window.scrollY >= document.body.scrollHeight - 4) {
        current = ids[ids.length - 1];
      }
      setActive(current);
    }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
    onScroll();

    var sw = document.getElementById('themeSwitch');
    var root = document.documentElement;
    function applyTheme(t) {
      if (t === 'light') root.setAttribute('data-theme', 'light');
      else root.removeAttribute('data-theme');
      sw.setAttribute('aria-checked', t === 'light' ? 'true' : 'false');
    }
    var saved = null;
    try { saved = localStorage.getItem('theme'); } catch (e) {}
    applyTheme(saved === 'light' ? 'light' : 'dark');
    sw.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var next = root.getAttribute('data-theme') === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light';
      applyTheme(next);
      try { localStorage.setItem('theme', next); } catch (e) {}
    });
  })();
</script>
